prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. "Himmelsgarten", a luxurious roof garden on top of a chrome skyscraper, high above the city, seen from above. Upper-city materials: polished white stone and chrome, glass, gold trim, lush green hedges and roses. A large open rooftop terrace of pale stone tiles fills most of the image - this is the large walkable area; in its middle a big square dance floor made of frosted glass tiles that glow softly from below in pale violet and cyan.
TOP CENTER: a raised speaker's bridge - the most eye-catching spot: a long elevated walkway with a glass and gold railing running left to right above the terrace, reached by short stairs at both of its ends, with a sleek golden lectern in its middle; under the bridge a solid wall with flower boxes.
TOP LEFT: the glass-and-gold doors of a guest elevator in a white wall, a velvet rope on brass posts and a small guest-check podium in front of it.
TOP RIGHT: a VIP lounge corner behind a low glass wall: white curved sofas, cushions, a small fire bowl, champagne table.
LEFT SIDE: long buffet tables with white tablecloths, silver dishes and champagne coolers. LEFT EDGE middle: a small chrome service elevator door set into the parapet.
RIGHT SIDE: an elegant curved bar counter of white marble with golden bar stools and shelves of bottles.
Across the terrace: several white rose arches (pergolas covered with red and white roses) arranged around the dance floor, drawn so they don't hide the floor; a raised flower bed with roses near the lower left.
BOTTOM LEFT: a row of tall trimmed hedges, and behind them a narrow gravel maintenance path running along the parapet, with a small kitchen back door at the left end.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a round landing pad with yellow-white markings and a sleek golden glider aircraft parked at the right edge; two thin radio antenna masts with red lights near the right edge.
BOTTOM CENTER: a narrow footbridge leaving the roof downward through a gap in the parapet, with golden lanterns.
All around the outer edge: a glass parapet with a golden handrail; beyond it only sky and far below the city.
Small stuff at the edges: potted palms, lantern poles with round glowing light globes, champagne coolers, a small gardening robot dock. Nothing on the walkable tiles in the middle.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP LEFT - the guest elevator doors; LEFT edge - the service elevator; BOTTOM center - the footbridge.
Time: bright clear morning above the clouds, fresh sunlight, long soft shadows.
